title: Akiyama Mizuki — Retail Therapy〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Diner

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I really wasn't expecting to run into Mafuyu here like this.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But guess what?! This one shop we went to today had these new outfits that would look so great on you and Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mizuki made a huge fuss about that when we were there too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha! Yeah, I did!
So, Mafuyu, wanna invite Kanade and check it out together the next time we can?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Together...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah... We don't know when we'll be able to, but let's set aside some time when we can, okay?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'll think about it...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It's nice that she sort of wants to go out shopping and stuff with us again.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (And us chatting like this will hopefully help give her some reprieve from what's been happening!)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Hmm... What should we talk about next...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Oh, I know...!)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Speaking of which, we went shoe shopping after looking at clothes. Ena took like twenty minutes to decide whether or not to buy the pair she was looking at...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Well all of the little signs for them only had good things written about them which was really shady...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Shady...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: They look like an ordinary pair of sneakers, but they apparently help you lose weight just by having them on your feet...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: The soles seemed to be designed in a way to make it deliberately hard to maintain your balance, so I guess your legs would sort of get a workout just by walking around in them.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: They even had these videos playing which seemed to show that they actually work...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: All that leaves is for her to actually put them on and exercise...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I doubt she will...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hey, I...
Might've if I bought them...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Then, why didn't you buy them?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Even if they don't work as advertised, you'd be motivated to work out and lose weight, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, what she said. You would've felt compelled to exercise and get your legs in shape.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, maybe you should've bought them.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? What are you two getting at?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I mean, Mizuki... You don't really exercise since you usually stay in your room while you work, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But you have a ton of stamina. Why is that?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. That's because I have three healthy meals every day. Unlike a certain someone...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Also, I have to stand, walk around and carry a bunch of stuff at my job.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: This other girl in my class also works in retail and seems much fitter than you, Ena...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh? I was under the impression that clothing store employees just stood around all day, but you have to stay pretty active, huh?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, hold up!
Standing around isn't easy! You have no idea how much my legs and back hurt after a shift!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Also, carrying around stuff takes a lot of out you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What else is there...? Oh, we have sales quotas to meet and have to get in a certain number of customers per day, so you need to be a smooth talker too.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
You do...?
That seems pretty easy for you, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha! I chose this job specifically because I thought I'd be great at it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Mizuki, your ribbon...
It's going to get stained...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Huh? Whoa, good catch!
It was about to dive right into my parfait!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: The ice cream's even starting to melt! You gotta eat it quick!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're right!
I got so into our conversation that I totally forgot about it!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Mafuyu? Is something wrong...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, Mafuyu didn't look so good when I went over to go talk to her...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Or am I just overthinking things...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, Mafuyu, you drank all your tea. Do you wanna order something else...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, it's okay...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We've still got some fries, so feel free to have some!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hey, Mizuki...
Can you take some of my parfait?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yours? Don't tell me you're already full.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Actually, I am... Kinda...
It was bigger than I was expecting...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I'm still working through mine...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Still, I won't be having dinner for a while, so I guess I can lend her a hand.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: If you insist...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Shall I have some?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki & Ena
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That'd be great, but... Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, aren't you having dinner soon...?
Also, the taste...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: A little should be fine.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I won't know how it tastes, but I don't think I'll hate it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: In that case, Mafuyu, let's help her together.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thanks, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You're welcome...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Is it just me or did Mafuyu smile ever so slightly just now...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I hope she's feeling a little better...)
